registry.scope: Exploratory candidate screening only; no final strategy or live activation

candidates.rule: resistance_breakout AND trend_1h=bullish AND trend_4h=bullish AND volatility in [low,normal]
resistance_retest AND trend_1h=bullish AND trend_4h=bullish AND volatility in [low,normal]
trend=ranging AND trend_1h=ranging AND trend_4h=ranging AND volatility in [low,normal] AND RSI crosses upward through 30 within same segment

registry.secondary_exit: 24h fixed hold, descriptive only; never substitute to rescue failed primary exit
registry.multiplicity: Retain the 28 Milestone 4 primary p-values and add 3 discovery comparisons; BY across all 31. This does not undo adaptive reuse or create fresh validation.
registry.selection: No automatic deployment. Only candidates passing every gate may be forwarded for separately reviewed Milestone 6 validation. If none pass, selected_strategy is null. No parameter grid or gate relaxation.

training.note: One purchase/one sale, no 5m signal delay. Observed 15m liquidation-value marks; gaps/intrabar extremes omitted. Different exposure from candidate diagnostics.

reused_recent.note: One purchase/one sale, no 5m signal delay. Observed 15m liquidation-value marks; gaps/intrabar extremes omitted. Different exposure from candidate diagnostics.
